the optimised schedule holds no sold reduction floor: src.sched.Commitment has no site_id and applies to every site in a call, so a portfolio floor cannot be posed without one solver call per site. `firm_kw` is what could be sold, not what was sold, and scorecard.floor_shortfall_kw_min is measured against no commitment.
the optimised schedule minimises energy cost plus a demand charge on each site's daily peak (src.sched.DEMAND_CHARGE_EUR_PER_KW_DAY); source is ASSUMED, see src/sched
sites are scheduled independently, so the per-site LPs were re-solved sequentially with a shadow price on the running portfolio load; the sweep with the lowest portfolio peak was kept

share of the day's charging energy the optimiser never placed (an infeasible site, or a session straddling the day boundary); it is carried at its uncontrolled baseline in the optimised curve, so the two curves cover the same sessions and the difference between them is only what was actually scheduled

penalty_eur and net_eur are null: src.market.settle() needs a delivery record per block, and this scenario dispatches no reduction event. Delivered-vs-promised is measured on POST /api/scenario/{id}/dispatch instead of being guessed here.
